name: Road to De Other Side: Muzah's leaps land inside his arena
contract: Issue #13536: Muzah (162711) could end up stuck in the wall of his arena. His leap (every 25 s) and the Glaive Strikers measure how far the wall is in a random direction from the arena middle (100.9, -123.9) and land 3 yd short of it. WorldObject::GetFirstCollisionPosition(startX, startY, startZ, destX, destY) adds the caller's orientation to that direction, so the wall was measured in another direction and the leap could land beyond the wall (seen in the red run: 24 yd out, without line of sight to the middle, on the first leap). Expected: the wall is measured along the leap direction, so Muzah always lands where he can see the middle of the arena. Muzah fights for about two minutes, five leaps; his line of sight to the middle is checked every second.
